verdict.rationale: BigCommerce is a commerce SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an MCP server, MCP endpoint, or agent-connection tooling. The llms.txt file, the AI-powered docs search and chat, the 'AI-ready page actions', and the REST/GraphQL APIs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
